articles.summary: Waystar (Nasdaq: WAY), a provider of leading healthcare payment software, today released The State of the Mid-Revenue Cycle report. The new research found unanimous interest among healthcare finance leaders in a single AI-powered platform connecting the mid-cycle to the final claim, yet 86% lack true integration between those systems, relying instead on manual data transfers or disconnected solutions across the revenue cycle.
